name: XChat 사례 큐레이터 봇
tagline: Feeds your XChat group fresh Grok-bot use cases, filtered, summarized, translated
description: On a repeating cycle it searches X for new ways people are using Grok bots, keeping only posts that include a template or a step-by-step how-to and skipping the hype. Each pick is summarized, translated and posted into an XChat group you run, so members get usable material instead of a firehose.
author: brandonchung75
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
